commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Luis Milla (Getafe) sends it out of play.
90+5' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Getafe.
90+2' Djene (Getafe) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
90+2' Allan Nyom (Getafe) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 1 Goal! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Giorgi Mamardashvili into middle of the goal.
90' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) is going to take the penalty!
89' Handball! A player from Valencia handled the ball.
88' The referee shows a yellow card to Hugo Duro (Valencia). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
88' Allan Nyom (Getafe) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
84' Here comes a substitution. Fran Perez (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Diego Lopez.
84' Substitution. Enzo Barrenechea leaves the pitch and is replaced by Hugo Guillamon (Valencia).
84' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. David Arguelles (Getafe) replaces Alex Sola.
81' The game is interrupted as Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) is flagged offside.
79' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
79' Alex Sola (Getafe) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
77' The attendance is 12412.
77' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
75' That's the end of the game for Jose Gaya, who is replaced by Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia).
75' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by German Valera.
74' Luis Milla (Getafe) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
74' Maximiliano Caufriez (Valencia) commits a rough foul. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and makes a call. Getafe will take a free kick.
72' Luis Rioja (Valencia) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
69' Luis Milla (Getafe) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
67' It's like he was asking for a caution. Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) receives a yellow card.
65' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
63' Getafe are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
60' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His almost perfect header hits the bar and ricochets away off it.
60' It seemed like Luis Milla (Getafe) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
58' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle and it's Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
55' Luis Milla (Getafe) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
54' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is the one who receives a yellow card.
52' Thierry Correia (Valencia) is substituted due to injury. Ruben Baraja gives a chance to Dimitri Foulquier.
50' Thierry Correia (Valencia) jumps into a tackle and Guillermo Cuadra signals a foul.
47' Getafe failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carles Perez departs the field of play to be replaced by Peter Federico (Getafe).
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez and he is replaced by Allan Nyom (Getafe).
46' Substitution. Christantus Uche (Getafe) in, Alvaro Rodriguez out.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' The resulting free kick from Alex Sola (Getafe) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
45+1' A yellow-coloured card is received by Thierry Correia (Valencia).
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Carles Perez (Getafe) gets a yellow card.
43' Carles Perez (Getafe) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
42' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
41' The referee has issued a yellow card to Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia).
40' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

36' 0 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes inside the left post, increasing the score of today's match – 0:1.
35' Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
35' Diego Lopez (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Valencia force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Valencia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

30' What a chance that is! Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
28' The corner from Luis Milla (Getafe) is cleared away by the defence.
26' Carles Perez (Getafe) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
25' Alex Sola (Getafe) is flagged for offside.
21' Carles Perez (Getafe) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
20' Hugo Duro (Valencia) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
19' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillermo Cuadra no option but to blow his whistle.
17' Diego Rico (Getafe) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.

16' Getafe slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
14' The linesman signals that Carles Perez (Getafe) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Getafe.

13' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.

11' Alvaro Rodriguez (Getafe) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
7' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
7' Alex Sola (Getafe) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
5' Valencia are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
2' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Alex Sola (Getafe).
